About me

I’m a digital marketer with 9+ years across WPP Media, Omnicom Media Group, in-house teams and global brands in Pakistan, Malaysia and Europe. I’ve led the in-house marketing function at a financial services brand, worked on award-recognized campaigns for FMCG brands and now run paid social for five HelloFresh markets.

I start with the content and brand idea, then use data and AI to ship it faster and show what worked. This portfolio shows the campaigns I’m proudest of: the problem, the idea, what I did and what it delivered.
